correctness.rationale: For the specified 18-vertex Pappus LCF graph, all 2^18 vertex subsets are tested for acyclicity. The lexicographic coordinate-toggle matching has precisely one critical 0-cell, one 9-cell, 62 10-cells and 21 11-cells, is acyclic, and its exact integral Morse boundaries have a surjective 1x62 map and primitive rank-21 image from Z^21. This gives reduced H_10=Z^40 with no other homology. The 8-connected Morse CW model is then 9-connected by Hurewicz, and Whitehead yields a wedge of forty 10-spheres. Separately, signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz sums over the full 216 graph automorphisms give the claimed 40,4,1,0 trace multiplicities, one invariant rational line and character inner-product ten.
risks: Integral homotopy type is nonequivariant; character is rational, not an integral representation decomposition.
